info.name: Juniper Networks Juniper Contrail Networking API

description.content:
Juniper Contrail (now Cloud-Native Contrail Networking) provides an SDN controller with a RESTful API for managing virtual networks, network policies, security groups, and service chaining. The API server runs on port 8082 and provides CRUD operations on networking objects. It supports multi-tenancy through project-based resource isolation and integrates with OpenStack, Kubernetes, and VMware orchestrators.
